name: Summit Electric Supply
old_description: There's a lot that goes into keeping your business running smoothly. You don't have to juggle it alone. Since 1977, we've been helping people like you get it done. Your success is our success.
about:
Summit Electric Supply, based in Gonzales, Louisiana, was founded in 1977. The company began with a focus on supplying electrical products to local businesses and has grown into a multi-segment distributor serving a wide geographic area. No founder names or ownership details are publicly disclosed.

Today the company stocks and distributes a comprehensive line of electrical materials — circuit protection, wire and cable, tools, wiring devices, lighting, connectors, enclosures, conduit and fittings, lamps and ballasts, hardware, and power distribution equipment. Its service model includes a Second Counter Service Guarantee®, 24/7 emergency delivery, free on-site assessments, and digital quick-order pads for bulk purchasing, all aimed at reducing lead times and inventory headaches.

Summit’s customer base spans commercial, residential, industrial, institutional, OEM, and marine sectors. Testimonials from a supply chain manager, a business development lead, an electrical foreman, and a CEO illustrate the range of roles that rely on the company for project quoting, technical support, and rapid material fulfillment.

The firm positions itself on three pillars — responsive, credible, reliable — promising that time-sensitive orders are met without delay, that its product quality and service reputation are unmatched, and that its industry experts are available around the clock to keep projects on track.
